beats.vo: ^This is the board in most classrooms. ^Chalk, dust, and a lot of waiting.
^Now imagine it as a giant tablet. ^You can write on it, tap it, and even talk to it. ^That's a smart board.
^But teachers have a dozen jobs before class even starts. ^Attendance. ^Slides. ^A quiz. ^Homework.
^Meet KINETIX Board. ^It does the busywork, so the teacher can just teach.
Let's spend one science lesson in Class 10 B. ^Here's Ms Kavya, the teacher. ^And here's Aarav, a student.
Today's topic: ^how light bends.
beats.title: One lesson, start to finish

beats.vo: First, she signs in. ^Scan the code with the teacher app, and she's in. No password on a big screen.
beats.title: Scan to sign in

beats.vo: Or, ^type the six-digit code instead.
beats.title: Or type 6 digits

beats.vo: No internet? ^A backup code still works offline.
beats.title: Works offline

beats.vo: Next, ^she sets her own PIN for this board.
beats.title: Personal PIN
